policies.with_check:
((auth.uid() = user_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (((messages m
     JOIN conversations c ON ((c.id = m.conversation_id)))
     LEFT JOIN conversation_participants cp ON (((cp.conversation_id = c.id) AND (cp.user_id = auth.uid()))))
     LEFT JOIN team_members tm ON (((tm.team_id = c.team_id) AND (tm.user_id = auth.uid()))))
  WHERE ((m.id = message_reactions.message_id) AND ((cp.user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (tm.user_id IS NOT NULL))))))
